assertions.name: sign_block_improvement_reproduced_at_both_anchors
assertions.source: Sign-block hypothesis IMPROVEMENT-vs-bare reproduced at both anchors within ±1 ppb. Note: absolute residual at q_muon includes m_μ over-determination effect (PR #1581 Probe A) — substrate property independent of which Wedderburn block hosts the EM correction.

description: Item 1 follow-up of PR #1645: discriminate which 1-dim Wedderburn block of H_3 hosts the proton's (α_em/π) EM correction. Tests cross-anchor invariance and stages a Lean §3b-cond conditional-class statement. Sign rep is the natural Fermi-statistics choice.

data.verdict: CROSS-ANCHOR CONSISTENT IN THE IMPROVEMENT METRIC. Both 1-dim Wedderburn blocks (sign V_(1,1,1) and trivial V_(3)) carry P = 1/6 and are numerically indistinguishable from each other. Their improvement over the bare baseline reproduces at both anchors (32262.4 at proton, 32262.6 at muon, within ±1 ppb). Their ABSOLUTE residuals do NOT agree across anchors (261.14 ppb at proton vs 5046.65 ppb at muon) — expected, since the muon leg carries the m_μ over-determination (PR #1581 Probe A), a substrate property independent of which Wedderburn block hosts the EM correction. The PHYSICAL discrimination is: proton color singlet = antisymmetric → SIGN rep is the natural Fermi-statistics channel. OPEN: Lean §3b-cond formalization of the conditional class ProtonMassEMSignBlock; Bring zero-mode derivation of the bare per-block (α_em/π); characterization of the absolute residual.
